source_text: Vox dilecti mei; ecce iste venit saliens in montibus, transiliens colles. Similis est dilectus meus capreae hinnuloque cervorum. En ipse stat post parietem nostrum, respiciens per fenestras, prospiciens per cancellos. Adventus Verbi velox et subtilis.
pass_a_gloss: Voice of-beloved my; behold this-one comes leaping on mountains, springing-over hills. Like is beloved my to-gazelle and to-young-of stags...
pass_b_english: [[The voice of my beloved; behold, he comes leaping on the mountains, springing over the hills. My beloved is like a gazelle and a young stag. Behold, he stands behind our wall, looking through the windows, peering through the lattices >> Bible:Song of Songs 2:8-9]]. The Word’s coming is swift and subtle.
